preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the lab is between 1 and 200,000.
The number of edges in the lab is between n - 1 and 200,000.
The number of clones is between 1 and the number of vertices.
The vertices indices are between 1 and n.
The graph is guaranteed to be connected.

postconditions.expression: Each clone must visit at least one vertex.
postconditions.description: Each clone must visit at least one vertex in the lab.

postconditions.expression: Each vertex must be visited by at least one clone.
postconditions.description: Each vertex in the lab must be visited by at least one clone.

postconditions.expression: Each route can have at most <image> vertices.
postconditions.description: Each route taken by a clone can have at most a number of vertices specified in the problem statement.
It is guaranteed that a valid answer exists for the given input.

invariants.expression: The graph is a connected graph.
invariants.description: The graph remains connected throughout the solution process.
